column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Wouldn't Accept A Souvenir
Well, like I've said, it's your souvenir, not mine! I have no such interest in Meruru!
...Huh?
What do you mean by "Huh"!? Isn't this what you wanted!?
...Why?
...It feels like this conversation isn't going anywhere.
Ah... could it be that this isn't the version you wanted?
Then you needn't worry. I already got you the complete set anyway! I've properly prepared all the different kinds.
...Annoying.
You neglect all my hard work with just one word...!
Why do you dislike this souvenir? I was certain that you wanted me to buy the Regional Edition Meruru...
...*sigh*
I seriously don't understand what you're talking about... You reek of otaku.
Reek of otaku!? That's harsh!
I'm going to cry if you don't cut it out already!
...Do whatever you want.
Say, have I mistaken something by any chance?
...Huh?
Like I said, you have to tell me if I did something wrong.
Tch...
Eh? Doesn't this conversation seem a bit off? What's going on?
Well then, what am I going to do with all these? Even though I went through so much trouble to buy them...
...If you don't need them, why not throw them away?
N-N-No, no matter what happens, I think throwing them away is just...
Tch...
I'm telling you, these are the things you asked me to get!
What have you been babbling about since earlier on anyway? You're seriously annoying.
It's Meruru! Why is your reaction so weak?
...I told you, I don't know about any of that stuff.
T-That stuff?
Hey, you really don't want them?
I don't want them.
You really, really don't want them?
I don't want them!
You really, really, really, really don't want them?
You're so persistent! I'm telling you I don't want them!
......Are you kidding me?
...Don't talk to me any more.
Just when I thought it's been a long time since we've last talked..
It's only been three days and you're calling that long?
Don't say it like we're close.
A-Are you actually going so far as to say that!?
...*sigh* you're unbelievable.
We've only been apart for three days... What the hell is going on!?
...What are you staring at?
Guh...
Ahhh, I'm seriously getting mad!
What's with that!?
...Don't ever talk to me again.
...Just when I thought I haven't talked to you in a long while... You're the worst coming here just to harass me.
I-In a long while?
Huh? What are you getting surprised for?
I haven't talked to her in a long while... she says....?
N-No way. Could this be the punchline in some dream....? Impossible?!
No, but thinking about it, having a little sister who's an otaku - is this like some Galge? At least that's the kind of setting that it feels like.
....So, this is reality and everything I was living up until now was all a dream....? So, all the development up until this point were my own wish....
What are you doing mumbling to yourself in your own little world...? Are you receiving strange radio waves?
